human_authorization.source: Human conversation instruction 2026-11-01: 批准，许可授权，直接做批量的测试吧; explicit follow-up confirms Human authority
human_authorization.scope: single verified recoverable test save; Player SHOT_TENDENCY live multi-intent multi-chunk tests; real native getters and bounded setters permitted
human_authorization.limits: 10-30 live/no-op candidates; first live mutation batch 10-20 valid intents if preconditions hold; limited extra observation batch only after clean success; no auto escalation to mass 10k writes

gates.name: Human authorization recognized
gates.pass: No duplicate Human approval; source grant bound to fixed scope and live preflight manifest; unauthenticated CLI flag alone cannot widen scope

gates.name: Technical preflight
gates.pass: Live executable SHA and PID epoch, save/roster context and recoverable backup independently confirmed

gates.name: Single-executor
gates.pass: No concurrent native mutation, durable claim before execution; unknown locks never automatically reconciled

gates.name: Native bridge and protocol
gates.pass: Existing REA CLI called with registered native bindings, full batch/save/plan/chunk IDs in envelope and verified getter/setter evidence

gates.name: Live No-op multi-chunk
gates.pass: At least 2 chunks, genuine game readback and no Setter calls

gates.name: Live bounded mutation batch
gates.pass: 10-20 authenticated live Player SHOT_TENDENCY intents if available, at least 2 chunks, no other fields, per-intent +1/-1, exact CAS and post-write verify

gates.name: Failure stop
gates.pass: CAS/UNKNOWN/cleanup failures lead to halt, no retries or auto rollback, conservative receipts

gates.name: Evidence and Loop
gates.pass: Real runner evidence separated from Fake/Node and reports true model, executable SHA, exact test command, bounded iteration and stop reason

stop_if: insufficient technical evidence, wrong build/save, no recoverable backup, inconsistent native results, unverified concurrent instance, scope overflow, missing safe UI state
